title: David and Jonathan Are Best Friends
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who looks until the good is found, and tonight Prince Jonathan sees the good in David and cheers instead of envying: Scout claps loudest when a friend wins the prize Scout wanted.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because a seeker knows how to look for the good in someone else. In Scout’s world today: Scout’s friend Mia wins the drawing prize at the library, and Scout’s picture does not get a ribbon at all. For one second Scout’s face feels hot. Then Scout looks again at Mia’s picture, a purple whale with a rainbow spout, and sees how good it really is. Scout claps the loudest of anybody and gives Mia the best sticker in the sticker book. Just like Jonathan cheering for David, Scout discovered that a real friend is happy when good things happen to you.
